flashcards.front: What does ingredient order tell you?
flashcards.back: Ingredients are listed by weight - the first ingredient makes up the most of the product.

flashcards.front: How many names does sugar have?
flashcards.back: Sugar has over 60 different names including fructose, corn syrup, dextrose, and maltose.
INS 211 is Sodium Benzoate, a preservative used to increase shelf life and prevent bacteria growth.

flashcards.front: Why are there so many ingredients in processed food?
flashcards.back: Each ingredient serves a purpose: flavor, texture, color, preservation, or cost reduction.
Foods with 5 or fewer ingredients are generally less processed and more natural.
Natural flavor can be derived from any plant or animal source, not necessarily the food it flavors.
Look for words ending in 'sodium' or containing 'salt' - there are over 40 forms of sodium in food.
Emulsifiers help mix oil and water, creating smooth textures in ice cream, chocolate, and sauces.

daily_tips.tip: Check the first 3 ingredients - they make up most of the product
Foods with shorter ingredient lists are usually healthier
Compare similar products - choose the one with fewer additives
